data.one_liner: Comprehensively view, annotate, edit, and sign PDFs in mobile Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to quickly add PDF viewing, annotation, editing, form filling, redaction, and signature capabilities to Android and iOS Flutter applications. It provides both a default built-in viewer UI and an embeddable CPDFReaderWidget.
use_when: You need robust PDF viewing, annotation, form-filling, or signing features in a mobile app.
You want a production-ready PDF UI without building custom low-level renderers from scratch.
avoid_when: Your target platforms include web or desktop (since it only documents Android and iOS support).
You are looking for a pure Dart open-source PDF rendering engine with no commercial dependencies.
strengths: Comprehensive PDF functionality including digital signatures, redaction, form filling, and annotations.
Provides both a ready-to-use default viewer and an embeddable CPDFReaderWidget.
Cross-platform support for iOS and Android with high-performance rendering.
weaknesses: Requires commercial licensing, native configuration steps (such as custom Podfiles or FragmentActivities), and an explicit XML license asset.
License details and pricing are unknown or proprietary.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a license key asset, setting Android minSdkVersion to 23+, updating Android launcher activity to FlutterFragmentActivity, and potentially adding native pods for iOS.
